name: GRAD 5500
title: Post-Baccalaureate Research Training
description: A non-credit course associated with supervised research training for post-baccalaureate students who are not registered for any other credit-bearing course and are participating in a sponsored research program. May be repeated. May be repeated for a total of 0 credits.
requirement_description: Completed undergraduate degree and participation in a sponsored program for research experience; instructor consent required.
